page: Microsoft Azure FX48mds is an FXMDVS family virtual machine running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture with Intel processors. The server is configured with 1008.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 21.0 GB per vCPU.

For local storage, the instance includes a 2064 GB local SSD. It is also Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance external storage volumes. The configuration does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses, and there are no onboard GPUs.

Given the high memory density of 21.0 GB per core, this instance is designed for memory-intensive workloads rather than general-purpose compute. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities, though the lack of specialized GPU hardware limits its applicability for accelerated computing tasks. This hardware profile is suitable for large-scale in-memory databases, heavy enterprise applications, and memory-bound data processing workloads.
